name: Turaco Gold Limited
summary: Turaco Gold Limited operates as a gold exploration and development company in Cote d'Ivoire. Its principal project is the Afema gold project comprising central mining permit and three contiguous exploration permits, an exploration permit application, and an option over an additional application covering an area of approximately 1,600 square kilometers located in south-east Côte d'Ivoire. The company was formerly known as Manas Resources Limited and changed its name to Turaco Gold Limited in July 2021. Turaco Gold Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
